title: Technology Sector Update for 07/02/2018: GOOG,MTLS,NEP
text:

CSCO -0.98%
GOOG -0.78%
Tech stocks were giving back Friday's strong advance, sinking ahead of Monday's opening bell.
Among technology stocks likely moving on news:
- Alphabet ( GOOG ) reportedly has invested in an electric scooter startup as part of a larger $300 million funding round that already included its Google Ventures affiliate. Google Ventures is said to be leading the funding rounds in Lime, but the Financial Times report did not specify how much Alphabet is investing in the funding round, although sources told the newspapert it matched Google Ventures' amount. The deal value the startup at $1.1 billion.
In other sector news:
- Materialise NV ( MTLS ) is seeking to raise up to $250 million through a mixed shelf registration that includes ordinary shares, American Depository Shares, preference shares and warrants, according to a regulatory filing by the software firm late Friday.
- NextEra Energy Partners LP ( NEP ) has completed the sale of its Canadian renewable energy assets to affiliates of Cordelio Power for CND740 million ($563 million). The transaction includes NextEra's former interests in four wind generation plants and two solar energy facilities, all located in Ontario having a combined generating capacity of 396 megawatts, the company said. Cordelio also assumed about CND889 million of existing NextEra debt.
